 Magnitude 5.7 Earthquake Hits Western Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan... "Caution Urged for Strong Aftershocks"
 Kim Hye-young 
 Seoul 
 Published 
 2026.11.08 12:35 
 View 
 View Count 
 PIP 닫기 
 An earthquake with a magnitude of 5.7 struck the western part of Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan, at around 1:04 AM today (November 8). 
 According to the Japan Meteorological Agency, the epicenter had a depth of 40 km. The quake left at least 12 people injured in Aichi Prefecture, mostly from hitting their heads, and injured 3 people in Shizuoka Prefecture as well. 
 The Japan Meteorological Agency warned, "Caution is needed for earthquakes with a maximum seismic intensity of around 5-strong over the next week," specifically advising that "the possibility of large-scale earthquakes is high" over the next two to three days.
